payload.summary: Planned a coordinator-managed LLM gateway: control/enforcement in the coordinator, a separate LiteLLM/OpenRouter proxy as the data plane. Depends on and integrates with add-adaptive-model-router (its ledger/policy stay the single source of truth). First consumer is the code-search embedder, which retires the D9 environment block.

decisions.title: Control plane in coordinator; data plane is a separate deployable
decisions.rationale: Inference is high-QPS/streaming/latency-critical; keeping it out of coordination_api preserves blast radius + profile (G1)

decisions.title: Router ledger/policy is the single spend source of truth
decisions.rationale: Budgets derive from router policy; spend flows back into the same ledger; only new table is a key-issuance audit — no second spend system (G2/G10)

decisions.title: Coordinator-issued virtual keys from vault-held master keys
decisions.rationale: Agents never hold provider master keys; trust level bounds issuable scope; fails closed if vault down (G3)

decisions.title: Gateway /embeddings is the code-search embedder
decisions.rationale: One provisioned endpoint unblocks add-semantic-code-search's spike environment gap (G6)

decisions.title: Explicit coverage boundary: meterable traffic only
decisions.rationale: Subscription CLIs can't be proxied and stay on the router's advisory path; do not sell the gateway as universal (G5)

next_steps: Gate/approve, then /implement-feature add-coordinator-llm-gateway (contracts + gateway deployable first)
